title: Savings Account Minimum Balance
content: Maintain the minimum average balance each month to avoid penalties. Digital channels show your MAB progress.

title: Debit Card Blocking
content: You can block your debit card instantly via mobile banking or call support for emergency blocking.

title: UPI Transaction Limits
content: Daily UPI limit is INR 1 lakh with up to 20 transfers; limits may vary by merchant category.

title: EMI Formula
content: EMI equals P*r*(1+r)^n divided by ((1+r)^n - 1) where r is the monthly interest rate.

title: NEFT Timings
content: NEFT transfers are available 24x7 with settlement in half-hour batches except during maintenance windows.

title: KYC Update
content: Submit fresh address proof and a passport photo via branch or secure upload to refresh KYC details.

title: Fixed Deposit Interest Payout
content: Interest on FDs can be paid monthly, quarterly, or on maturity based on the plan selected during booking.

title: Credit Card Billing Cycle
content: Billing cycle is typically 30 days with payment due 18-20 days after statement generation.

title: Account Statement Request
content: Download statements from net banking or request an email copy for up to 24 months of history.

title: Two Factor Authentication
content: Online transactions require OTP or biometric authentication to complete securely.
